reference_fact_schemas.common: REFERENCE batches. Rows of one role are emitted ordered by (effective_start_ns, reference_id) as the shared validator requires. instrument_id = member (declared/observed breadth) or the target entity (adaptive); session_id = target session. All fact roles of one request share one source_id and snapshot_id; text is null except where stated.

population.defined_by: contract E (ROBUST_PACE, PR 690, OQ-7), reused unchanged for the declared static population: one row per declared member, instrument_id = member, session_id = target session, reference_id x1:B(population_id) identical across members, effective bounds = target session bounds, text = snapshot id, price and factors null, known_at_ns nullable

membership_interval.why_distinct: E kind pins effective bounds to the session and has no stint identity, so it cannot express joins, leaves or re-entry; this kind is used only when membership_profile = ordered_history
membership_interval.effective_start_ns/effective_end_ns: membership interval [start, end), end null = open

current_return.price: signed int64 coefficient, only its sign is consumed; null = null_field

cumulative_volume.price: int64 shares >= 0 (library refuses negative with BOUNDS); null = null_field

endpoint_price.price: positive int64 coefficient at PriceUnit.scale; effective_start_ns = member event time

vwap.factor_den: cumulative volume in shares (positive); VWAP coefficient = price*factor_num/factor_den exactly

momentum.price: signed int64, only sign consumed; null = null_field

members (observed).text: group label or null (not the snapshot id)
members (observed).effective_start_ns: record time; records at or after C are not yet observed

change / qualifier_price / qualifier_vol.price: change: signed, sign only; qualifier_price: positive coefficient at scale; qualifier_volume: int64 shares >= 0

observations (adaptive).price/factor_num/factor_den: supplied raw rate in shares per second = price*factor_num/factor_den; factors both null (meaning 1/1) or both positive; price >= 0; null price = null_field

quality.rule: all applicable reasons retained lexically; status follows the first applicable reason in precedence; value null exactly when not available; available requires observed = expected

fixture_notation: compact, NOT canonical wire. Declared: C, K, scale (default 2), roles keyed by short name pra/ret/vol/ep/vwap/mom/hi/lo plus population; role None = absent delivery, cov incomplete = declared incomplete coverage; member rows default known_at ka 60 and event time t 50; ka null = unknown, ka 150 > K future; t >= C future_market; v null = null value; pra k available|unavailable; vwap k rat (num, den) | unavailable; population rows m, s, end, ka, stint. Observed: roles members(g=group label)/chg/qp/qv. Adaptive: times in ns (fixtures use seconds x 1e9), rows q (sequence), t, rate [price, factor_num, factor_den] or null, known_at default = t. Float cells list exact rational, float64, float.hex and exact_representable. hand_asserted holds the hand-typed expectation strings (i: int, f: exact fraction, b: bool, u: status:reasons:expected/observed); the remaining outputs of each fixture are evaluator-derived.

decisions_ruled.text: Hosting: an EF3 module in packages/features, config namespace ef3.*, separate catalog, no version bump (coordinator ruling).

The declared static population reuses fact kind ef3.population.member exactly as defined by contract E (OQ-7). Eligibility is not a per-row flag: a member that is not eligible is not declared. A distinct kind ef3.breadth.membership_interval exists only for the ordered_history profile because the E kind cannot express intervals or re-entry.

SD-1 (duplicate identity) is stated once, in contract E (RF12): a duplicate (instrument, session, reference_id) is rejected with DUPLICATE. This contract only cites it; the one extension is that overlapping stints of one member are the same identity (RB03).

Count and fraction outputs are null unless every selected member is determined for that output (analogue of multi-venue D01). Partial knowledge is carried by quality expected = N, observed = determined members. Alternative: partial counts as lower bounds (not adopted).

The denominator of every fraction is N, the declared population size at C; missing members never shrink it. A member whose input is KNOWN inapplicable (prior unavailable, vwap unavailable, zero range) is not directional / not satisfying and stays in N.
Three-valued logic per member (true, false, unknown): a known false decides a predicate without its other inputs (dominance); unknown never becomes false.

Direction comes from the supplied signed current return, sign only, exact zero is unchanged, no epsilon; a member is directional only with prior_reference available. The existing breadth.direction_counts (completed-return horizon, EQ035) is not reused.
Up (down) volume is the whole cumulative volume of members whose current direction is up (down); a direction flip moves the whole volume.
advance_decline_ratio = A/D and up_down_volume_ratio = up/down; a zero denominator is not_applicable/zero_denominator even when the numerator is also 0.
Above VWAP is strict (endpoint > vwap); VWAP is an exact rational notional/volume pair, not a float.
Positive momentum is strictly greater than 0 on a sign-only supplied value.

Proximity is range based and inclusive: near_high iff H - E <= t_h*(H - L); near_low iff E - L <= t_l*(H - L); t_h and t_l are independent reduced rationals in [0,1], no default. H = L is not near; H < L or E outside [L,H] is ineligible. Alternative: level-based tolerance (future label).
latest_observed_member_event_ns is the maximum endpoint-price event time when all members are determined, or the maximum if it equals C-1 (saturation, coverage 1/1), else null (multi-venue D08).
Empty selected population (N = 0): every output null, not_applicable, empty_universe, expected = observed = 0.

Evaluation point is C; membership is start <= C < end; facts are as of C (effective_start < C, known_at <= K); no backfill and no cross-evaluation state. First entry contributes with its as-of facts. Reset is a new request and session. A correction is a new snapshot id; one batch never holds two revisions; no arbitration.
Non-price quantities (volume, return, momentum) travel in the REFERENCE price column; all roles of a request share one PriceUnit; the scale is unused for them.
Each role holds at most 4096 rows.
Units members, ratio, shares, fraction, utc_ns; members and ratio are new to the ledger, utc_ns is already applied by the EF1 amendment.

The observed profile is a separate producer with its own identity and names breadth.observed.*; the roster defines the population; there is no expected population, and observed records can never feed the declared producer.
A member qualifies iff price >= floor_price and volume >= floor_volume (both inclusive, caller floors, no default); a known failure decides without the other input.
advancing = qualifies and change > 0; advance_fraction = advancing/qualifying; qualifying_fraction = qualifying/observed.
Group scope is configuration: one result per group label, label carried in the roster row text; ungrouped records belong to the cohort scope only.
Empty observed scope: counts are available zeros, fractions zero_denominator (an observed zero is an observation).
unknown_member_count is always available when the roster is.

The raw rate is a supplied exact rational in shares per second. Baseline: B_1 = r_1; B_k = (tau*B_{k-1} + d_k*r_k)/(tau + d_k), d_k the elapsed ns; alpha = d/(tau+d) (rational, no exponential). Alternatives: exponential decay, fixed-count EMA.
Warm-up W observations; baseline_available = n >= W; an observation is scorable when k >= W+1.
Relative rate rho_k = r_k/B_{k-1}; B_{k-1} = 0 makes that observation unscorable (counts exposed); alternative: any zero baseline makes the peak null.
Relative acceleration u_k = (r_k - r_{k-1}) * 10^9/(d_k * B_{k-1}) in 1/s, defined for d_k > 0 and B_{k-1} > 0.
Equal timestamps are allowed (ordered by sequence); alpha = 0, acceleration undefined. Alternative: reject equal times.
Peaks are maxima over scored observations; ties resolve to the earliest; the witness is that observation event time.
Scope is observations with t < C; all must be known (known_at <= K) and have a rate; a null rate is null_field for the rate outputs; later rows are ignored whatever their state.
Per-epoch reset; no state capability in v1 (update, restore and merge unsupported); output is a pure function of the prefix.
F0721 is the I/O grouping of the produced headers (not a header); the summary is as of C. F0700 and F0701 are the supplied identity and event clock.
Only F0699 is mapped (baseline_available); F0690, F0692 and F0694 to F0698 are unmapped.

Numeric policy: integers exact; declared and observed floats are a single correctly rounded division of exact integers (bit exact); adaptive floats are the single rounding of the exact rational with R17 acceptance max(8 ulp, 1e-12*|r|), +0.0 required where exact zero is argued.

rulings_on_open.text: The adaptive_volume family is defined generically by this contract and claims no equivalence with the audit opaque rows. F0690, F0692 and F0694 to F0698 are recorded as unmapped (open audit item, not a gate for this contract); F0699 is mapped to baseline_available.
No generic peak over the #490 relative-volume operand in v1 (a later amendment).
VWAP is supplied as an exact notional/volume pair; a float64 VWAP is not accepted.
The supplier may declare a prior reference or a VWAP unavailable (explicit missing, coverage stated); it is never inferred.
Role row bound 4096, as the R17 bound (integer(count, 1, 4096) in packages/intraday/src/equity_features_intraday/_context.py).

Non-price quantities (volume, return, momentum, rate) travel in the REFERENCE price column as the integer-coefficient carrier convention of the EF1/EF2 REFERENCE rows, unit taken from the role declaration. Checked in packages/contracts validation.py and inputs.py: the REFERENCE branch of validate_batch checks only identity uniqueness, (effective_start_ns, reference_id) order, interval bounds and positive rational factors; the negative-quantity check names only the size, bid_size, ask_size, volume and trade_count columns, so the price column accepts signed and zero values (the library adds its own BOUNDS for negative volume); CanonicalBatch requires a price_unit when a price column exists, so all roles share one PriceUnit.
Adaptive seed (first observation), window convention (the supplied rate is taken as given; its window belongs to #513/#492) and session summary final when the market cutoff is reached, as proposed.
Observed group scope stays a config parameter (one result per group label).
Cite contract E sections by name (population kind ef3.population.member and the duplicate-identity rule); cohort normalization cites the same text.

New units members (exists in the breadth catalog, new to the header ledger), ratio, shares/s and 1/s are accepted as additive, applied by the sibling amendment; the 33 headers are listed in the contract.

Other open items, coordinator-decided as the most conservative option: update, restore, merge unsupported; reset epoch mode only; the summary is a pure function of the prefix; no defaults for tolerances, floors, tau, W or windows; no partial or lower-bound counts.

coordinator_freeze: Per the coordinator, frozen as ef3-breadth1 (ef3.session_breadth), ef3-obsbreadth1 (ef3.observed_breadth) and ef3-adaptive1 (ef3.adaptive_volume), v1, for implementation once PR 691 merges; the author makes no acceptance claim.
